Dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#939),
I am afraid the [Clever Woman](../books.html#58) cannot come out till March, as [Hogg](../others.html#159) gives me no hope of finishing her before that time—so it would be hardly worth while to begin printing her till the beginning of the year.
I have sent all the rest of the [Golden Deeds](../books.html#51) direct to the printers, they will end with [Dr.

Kane.](../persons.html#1915)

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
